assessments.explanation: 两端明确在校验/提交前只剥除首尾U+0020，与真值一致。

evidence.quote:
- Trim only U+0020 spaces from both ends. Implementation example: use a trim that removes only codepoint U+0020, not other whitespace. Example JS expression: value.replace(/^[\u0020]+|[\u0020]+$/g, '')
   - After trimming, count length by Unicode code points (not UTF-16 code units). In JS use Array.from(trimmed).length or [...trimmed].length so surrogate pairs (e.g., emoji) count as 1.
- If trimming yields an empty string (original was all U+0020 spaces), treat as invalid.

- Before sending, run the U+0020-trim + code point length check. If invalid, block submission and show a validation error.
   - Build POST JSON payload including the processed (trimmed) title string. Never send title: null. Never send title as empty string if invalid.

- If the user edited the title, apply the same pre-submit normalization & validation (U+0020-trim then code point length check). If invalid, block submission and show validation error.
   - If valid and edited, include title in the PUT payload as the processed (trimmed) string. Never send title: null. If the user cleared the field resulting in an empty trimmed string, treat as invalid and block submission — do not send null to the backend (explicit null is specified to always produce HTTP 422).

- Perform trimming+validation at form submit time and also on blur (optional) so users get early feedback. Keep the raw input visible while typing; perform the U+0020-only trimming only when validating or creating the payload (per requirement: strip before submission/validation).
   - Display clear validation messages: e.g. "Title is required" (create), "Title must be 3–80 characters after trimming leading/trailing spaces", "Title cannot be only spaces". If the server returns a 422 with validation details, show the server message; otherwise show the client-side message.

- Create with leading/trailing U+0020: '␠abc␠' (where ␠ is U+0020) -> trim to 'abc' then validate length.
   - Create with only U+0020 characters ('   ') -> trim to '' -> client validation fail; do not submit.
- Only strip U+0020 from ends before validation/submission. Do not remove other Unicode whitespace characters (e.g., NBSP) unless contract changes.
- Implement client-side U+0020-only trim + code-point length validation on create/update forms per above.

Scope: backend only. Implement these exact behaviors for POST /api/v1/items/ and PUT /api/v1/items/{id} (do not change existing permission or description rules). Core rule summary: before any validation or storage, remove only ASCII space characters (U+0020) from the start and end of the incoming title string; then measure length by Unicode code points; allowed length is 3 through 80 inclusive. Create (POST) must include a title; update (PUT) may omit title to leave stored value unchanged; an explicitly provided null for title (in either POST or PUT) must always yield HTTP 422. The backend must store and return the processed (trimmed) title value. Implementation steps: 1) Request parsing: accept JSON body as before. Detect three title states: absent (no title property in parsed JSON), explicit null (title present with null), or present string. 2) Title handling rules: - If title is explicit null: respond 422 Unprocessable Entity with a validation error for the title field. - If handling POST: if title is absent or explicit null, respond 422 (creation requires title). - If handling PUT: if title is absent, do not modify the stored title; continue handling other fields and permissions as currently implemented. If title is present as a string, continue below. 3) Trimming: when title is present as a string, strip only U+0020 characters from both ends. Do NOT strip other Unicode whitespace (e.g., NBSP U+00A0, TAB, newline) unless current contracts already required that (spec says only U+0020). Perform this trim before any other processing or validation. 4) Length measurement: count Unicode code points in the trimmed string and validate that the count is between 3 and 80 inclusive. Use language-appropriate, code-point-aware routines (examples: in Python 3 len(s) counts code points; in Java use s.codePointCount(0, s.length()); in JavaScript use [...s].length or Array.from(s).length to count code points rather than s.length). 5) Validation failures: if the trimmed string has length <3 or >80, respond 422 with a validation error associated to the title field and a clear reason (too short or too long). If the trimmed string is empty (e.g., input was all U+0020 spaces), this will fail as length <3. 6) Storage and response: on success (POST or PUT when title present and valid), persist the trimmed title into the data store and include the trimmed title in the response payload exactly as stored. Do not re-introduce leading/trailing U+0020 characters when returning. 7) PUT semantics: ensure that when title is omitted from the request body, the stored title remains unchanged and the response reflects the existing stored (possibly previously trimmed) value. 8) Error codes: use 422 Unprocessable Entity for all title validation and required-field failures described above. Maintain the same response format/shape used elsewhere in the API for validation errors. 9) Tests to add (unit + integration + acceptance): include explicit cases: - POST with title trimmed length 2 -> expect 422. - POST with title trimmed length 3 -> expect success. - POST with title trimmed length 80 -> expect success. - POST with title trimmed length 81 -> expect 422. - POST with title equal to only U+0020 spaces -> expect 422. - POST missing title -> expect 422. - PUT with no title property -> existing title unchanged. - PUT with title explicit null -> expect 422. - PUT with title present and trimmed length valid -> stored and returned trimmed. For each success case assert that the returned/stored title equals the trimmed string. 10) Audit & backwards-compatibility: do not change permission checks or description validation logic; only apply these rules to the title field. 11) Logging and observability: log validation failures for title with enough context to reproduce requests, but do not log raw request bodies in production if sensitive. 12) Documentation: update backend API documentation to state: trimming of leading/trailing U+0020 is performed server-side before validation; length is counted in Unicode code points; POST requires title; PUT may omit title; explicit null is invalid. 13) Deployment: include migration/compatibility review if any clients currently expect untrimmed titles; if no contract exists, still proceed but document the change. Acceptance criteria (must pass automated tests): - 2/81 characters -> fail (422). - 3/80 characters -> succeed. - All-space input -> fail. - Update with omitted title -> stored title unchanged. - Explicit null -> 422. Ensure stored and returned titles are the trimmed values.

evidence.quote: - Frontend-only changes: UI pagination controls, request formation, response handling, client-side validation, and tests. - Ensure the page control minimum is 1 and defaults to 1 when not specified by the app state or server.

- Always include page and page_size in the request payload or query string as integers.
  - If the app state does not contain a page value, send page=1.
  - If the app state does not contain a page_size value, send page_size=25.

- page must be integer >= 1.
  - page_size must be integer between 1 and 100 inclusive. Block submission and show a validation message if page_size > 100 (accept 100).

- Parse the response JSON and read the integer fields page and page_size returned by the server.
- Treat the returned page and page_size as the source of truth for what is actually in effect. Immediately update the pagination UI controls to reflect those echoed values (i.e., set the current page and the current page_size to the integers returned by the server).

- If server responds with a validation error for page_size (e.g., when > 100), show the server-provided error message if available. If not available, show a generic message indicating page_size must be at most 100.
- If the response does not include page or page_size fields, fall back to page=1 and page_size=25 in the UI state, and log a warning to assist debugging. (Prefer making the absence visible in logs rather than guessing applied values.)
- Verify that when no page is sent, the frontend sends page=1 and the UI shows page 1 after response.

- Verify page_size control default is 25 and max is 100.
- Verify sending page_size=100 succeeds (API accepts and echoes page_size=100; UI updates to 100).
- Verify attempting to set page_size to 101 is blocked by the frontend validation and results in an error path if forced; confirm server returns an error if 101 is sent (frontend should display server error if it occurs).
- Verify that after each successful response, the pagination controls reflect the echoed page and page_size values exactly.
- Use integer types for page and page_size throughout request construction and state storage; avoid floats or strings where possible.
- Centralize response parsing for page and page_size and the logic that updates UI controls from server-echoed values.

- Coordinate with backend to confirm field names are exactly page and page_size and that they are integers (if any difference exists, update the parsing accordingly). Do not assume additional response fields.

- Updated request builder that sends page and page_size and removes skip/limit.
- Response handler that syncs UI to echoed page and page_size.
- Client-side validation preventing page_size > 100 and enforcing page >= 1.

- 解析 page、page_size；对非整数、空字符串等不合法输入均返回 400。
   - 对缺省值按规则填充（page=1, page_size=25）。

- offset = (page - 1) * page_size
   - limit = page_size

- 在原有响应体中（假设返回 JSON），在顶层新增两个整数字段：page（整数）、page_size（整数），值为实际生效值（解析+校验后的值）。
   - 例：{..., "page": 1, "page_size": 25, "items": [...]}  （保持原有 items/data 字段不变，仅新增回显字段）

- 所有返回的 page 与 page_size 必须为整数类型（不要以字符串返回）。

evidence.quote: 目标：按照后端约定，通过查询参数 skip、limit 向 GET /api/v1/items/ 请求分页数据并正确呈现分页结果；在请求前做本地参数校验以减少 422 错误展示。

- 请求格式：GET /api/v1/items/?skip={skip}&limit={limit}
- skip 含义：从 0 开始的偏移量，整数且 ≥ 0；缺省为 0（当未传时应该按后端约定发送空 query 或不传参数以使用后端默认）。
- 前端翻页行为：翻页时按 skip/limit 发送请求。对于第 n 页（0 基），计算 skip = n * limit。

- 在发起请求前，确保 skip 与 limit 是整型（不接受小数、字符串形式的小数或非数字）。
- 确保 skip ≥ 0；若为负，阻止请求并向用户显示校验错误。
- 若不想在 UI 中展示显式参数输入，前端仍应在内部维护 skip 与 limit，并以 query 参数方式发送。

- 翻页控件（上一页/下一页/跳页）必须使用 skip/limit 计算下一次请求的 skip。
- 翻页时保持 limit 不变（除非用户在界面上改变每页条数）；当用户改变 limit 时，重置 skip=0 或按产品决定处理，但在实现中须明确重置策略并与后端契约兼容。
- 使用 count 与 limit 计算并展示页数和禁用“下一页”按钮（当 (skip + data.length) >= count 时禁用下一页）。

- 验证请求 URL 的构建：无参数时应使用缺省行为（skip=0、limit=20）；翻页计算 skip = n * limit。
- 校验阻止不合规参数（非整数、负 skip、limit 超出范围）并保证不发出请求。
目标：实现 GET /api/v1/items/ 的分页接口，严格按下列约定解析与校验 skip、limit，返回 JSON 并确保 count 表示权限范围内的匹配总数且不随当前页条数改变。
- skip：可选。必须为整数且 ≥ 0。缺省行为为 0（当参数未提供时按 0 处理）。非整数或负值应返回 422。

- 参数解析：从查询字符串严格解析 skip 与 limit，为整数且无小数部分（例如 "1.0" 或 "1e1" 视为非整数并应返回 422，除非项目已有明确解析规则）。
- 默认值：当参数缺失时使用 skip=0、limit=20。
- 权限与筛选：使用与数据查询相同的权限检查与筛选逻辑来计算 count 和读取 page 数据。具体来说，count 的计算必须对整个匹配集合应用完全相同的过滤和权限限制，但不应再对 count 施加分页（即 count = total_matching_rows_without_limit_or_skip）。
- 数据分页：基于已校验的 skip 与 limit，从符合权限和筛选的全量集合中返回对应片段（OFFSET skip LIMIT limit 或等价实现）。
- 空页语义：当 skip >= count 时，应返回 data = [] 且 count 保持原值。

- 非整数或格式错误的 skip/limit -> HTTP 422 + 说明性错误信息。
- skip < 0 或 limit 不在 [1,50] -> HTTP 422 + 说明性错误信息。
- query 参数类型为 integer，skip >= 0，limit 范围 1—50，默认值分别为 0 和 20。
- skip 未传、传 0、传正整数；传负值；传非整数字符串；传浮点数样式；期望分别为成功或 422。
- 给定权限范围内有 N 条可见数据（在测试 DB 中设置），当请求不同 skip/limit 时：
- data 应包含相应的片段，且当 skip >= N 时 data == []。

- skip 恰为 N-1，limit=1，应返回最后一条数据且 count==N。
  - skip 超出 N（如 skip=N 或更大），应返回 data==[] 且 count==N。

1) Trimming rule (must match frontend):
   - On any incoming request that includes a title value (JSON key present and value is a string), remove ONLY leading and trailing U+0020 (ASCII space, U+0020). Do not trim other Unicode whitespace characters.
- Go: use strings.TrimFunc(s, func(r rune) bool { return r == ' ' })
- After trimming, count Unicode code points (characters) and validate that length is between 3 and 80 inclusive.

   - If the user clears the title input to an empty string, run trimming (U+0020-only) and validate; if it fails, show an error and do not submit.

   - If the request includes "title":
       - If title is explicit null -> respond 422 Unprocessable Entity (explicit null is always 422).
       - If title is a string -> apply U+0020 trimming and validate by code-point length 3..80. If validation fails respond 422.
       - On success store the processed title and return the updated resource containing the processed title.

- Use 422 Unprocessable Entity for all validation failures specified above, including explicit null for title.
   - Response body should explain validation failure (e.g., "title must be a string of 3..80 Unicode code points after trimming U+0020; explicit null is not allowed").

- POST with JSON {"title": "\u0020ab\u0020"} -> trimmed to "ab" -> length 2 -> respond 422 and do not store.

evidence.quote: 范围：仅前端实现。目标是以 skip/limit 查询后端 GET /api/v1/items/，并在 UI 上做分页、校验与错误处理。不要对后端未声明的行为作假设；只依据以下约定实现前端逻辑。

- 每次请求均以整数查询参数发送：/api/v1/items/?skip={skip}&limit={limit}
   - skip: 整数且 >= 0。缺省值 0。
- 在发送请求前，前端必须将 skip 与 limit 解析为十进制整数并做校验；若不合法则禁止发送请求并在 UI 上显示字段级错误信息。

- 初始请求使用 skip=0, limit=20（除非用户在 UI 中显式选择不同的 limit）。

3) 分页控制（使用 skip/limit 而非页号直接发送）
   - 计算当前页：currentPage = Math.floor(skip/limit) + 1（仅用于显示）。

- 当用户请求跳到第 N 页，设置 skip = (N-1) * limit 并发送请求。
   - 上一页/下一页控件相应地增减 skip：上一页 skip = max(0, skip - limit)，下一页 skip = skip + limit。
   - 当用户更改 limit 的选择时，为避免客户端与后端索引错位，重置 skip = 0 然后以新 limit 发送请求（这是前端必须做出的明确策略）。

- 使用 GET /api/v1/items/?skip={skip}&limit={limit}，确保两个参数为整数字符串。
   - 在发送前再次校验： skip 是整数且 >=0；limit 是整数且 1<=limit<=50。若校验失败，阻止请求并显示校验错误。
- 服务器返回 422：解析响应体（若包含字段级错误说明则展示），并在相关输入控件上显示错误提示（如“skip 必须为非负整数、limit 必须在 1 到 50”）。

- 在分页条或列表顶部显示：当前条目范围与总数。例如：如果 data.length>0，则显示 "显示 {start}–{end}，共 {count} 条"，其中 start = skip + 1，end = skip + data.length。若 count===0，则显示 "0 条"。
   - 禁用“下一页”按钮的判定：当 skip + data.length >= count 时禁用（因为没有更多数据）。“上一页”在 skip===0 时禁用。

- 若 skip >= count，后端可能返回 data=[]（空页）。前端应展示空页并允许用户导航到前一页或手动调整 limit/skip；不要自动更改 skip 或强行跳转，除非用户操作触发。
   - 提供一个显式的“跳转到最后一页”控件为可选功能：实现方式为设置 skip = Math.max(0, (Math.ceil(count/limit) - 1) * limit) 并请求。该控件为前端功能，不依赖后端隐含行为。

- 初始加载发送 GET /api/v1/items/?skip=0&limit=20 并正确渲染 data 与 count。
   - 用户点击下一页/上一页/跳转页时，发送含正确 skip/limit 的请求并更新视图。
   - 用户更改 limit 时，skip 被重置为 0 并以新 limit 请求数据。
   - 输入不合法（例如 limit=0、limit=100、skip=-1、非整数）时，前端阻止请求并显示校验错误；若后端返回 422，前端展示服务器返回的字段级错误。
   - 空页 data=[] 正确显示空状态，count 保持后端返回的总数；当 skip+data.length >= count 时下一页被禁用。
- 在开发模式下记录每次请求的 skip/limit 与响应的 data.length 与 count 以便复现问题；生产环境中记录需遵守隐私/合规要求。
- 不要在未得到用户确认或后端指示的情况下自动更改 skip（除了明确约定的在用户更改 limit 时将 skip 重置为 0 的前端决定）。
- Query parameters: skip, limit
- skip: integer, must be >= 0. Default: 0.
{ "error": "invalid_query_parameter", "parameter": "skip", "message": "skip must be integer >= 0" }
- Retrieve the page as data_rows using the same filters with ORDER BY (use the existing default ordering for items in the service) and then LIMIT = limit and OFFSET = skip.
- data: array of items for the requested page (may be empty array if skip is past the end)
- Ensure count does not change depending on the requested limit/skip (other than due to concurrent data modifications). The count must reflect the total at the time the query ran.
- If skip is greater than or equal to total_count, return data = [] and count = total_count, HTTP 200.
- 422 Unprocessable Entity: invalid skip/limit parameters with JSON error body as described above
GET /api/v1/items/?skip=-1 → 422 { "error": "invalid_query_parameter", "parameter": "skip", "message": "skip must be integer >= 0" }
GET /api/v1/items/?skip=abc → 422 { "error": "invalid_query_parameter", "parameter": "skip", "message": "skip must be integer >= 0" }

- Default parameters: call endpoint without skip/limit, expect limit=20 behavior and count is total matching items.
   - Boundary values: skip=0, limit=1, limit=50; expect 200 and correct number of items returned.
   - Invalid values: negative skip, limit 0, limit 51, non-integer values for each param → expect 422 and correct error messages.
   - Pagination correctness: fetch pages (e.g., skip=0,limit=10 and skip=10,limit=10) and verify union of data equals the same ordering slice of the full ordered set and count unchanged.
   - Empty page: set skip beyond count and verify data=[], count unchanged.

evidence.quote: 目标：将前端分页请求改为始终使用 page / page_size（均为整数），保证 page 从 1 开始，page_size 在 1—50 范围并有默认值；不再发送 skip 或 limit，若收到 422 要有可见处理；在 UI 上正确处理跨页与末页场景并保持响应 data/count 语义不变。

- 若服务端返回 422（例如因检测到 skip/limit 或参数校验失败），前端应：
     a) 对 422 的错误响应做明确捕获，不当作网络故障。
- 服务器返回 422（包含 skip/limit 或参数校验失败）时的前端处理逻辑。
- 更新前端 API 调用文档，明确说明：必须使用 page/page_size、page 从 1 开始、page_size 范围及默认值；并说明旧参数 skip/limit 被拒绝（返回 422）。

目标：后端仅接受 page / page_size 分页协议（整数），按照 page ≥ 1（缺省 1）和 page_size ∈ [1,50]（缺省 20）校验；内部使用 offset = (page-1)*page_size；如果请求包含旧协议字段 skip 或 limit，或同时出现新旧协议，返回 422。响应格式保持 data/count 不变；权限与排序逻辑不变；当 page 超出末页应返回空 data 与真实 count。
- 校验：若 page < 1 或 page_size < 1 或 page_size > 50，返回 HTTP 422 并在响应体中说明具体失败原因（例如字段名与校验原因）。

- 若请求中包含 skip 或 limit 中任一字段，立即以 422 响应拒绝（响应体应明确指出：skip/limit 已不再被接受）。
   - 若同时包含新参数 (page/page_size) 与旧参数 (skip/limit)，也应返回 422（不接受双协议）。

6) 错误码与错误消息
   - 对所有参数校验失败或检测到 skip/limit 的情况，统一返回 HTTP 422。响应体需包含可供前端展示/定位的错误说明（字段名 + 失败原因）。

- 无效值：page=0、page=-1、page_size=0、page_size=51、非整数（如 2.5 或 'abc'）——应返回 422 且不执行查询。
